senses.gloss: m. (נסא, v. נְסַח) peel, shovel for taking bread out of the oven.
units: <cite ref="Taanit 25a:2">Taan. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>אייתי מ׳ וכ׳</he> bring the shovel, for thy bread is getting charred.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 27a:10">Bekh. 27ᵃ</cite> <he>שקלה לה בריש מ׳</he> she takes the priest’s gift of the dough on the point of the shovel (to avoid direct contact).
